title: Croatia - 2026.08.06
notes: Croatia's economy is still expanding, but growth is losing momentum across multiple fronts as the European Commission projects a steady deceleration through 2027. At the same time, inflation remains above the euro-area norm, leaving households squeezed even as the government insists the worst of the price shock has passed. Together, the two trends are testing the credibility of the ruling coalition ahead of a period of tighter fiscal conditions.
